dashboard.emptyDescription: Add your first vehicle to start building its history.

settings.title: Settings
settings.odometerReminderWeekdayInfo: On that day, from the reminder time, we notify you once about active vehicles with no odometer reading for 7 days or more. Choose "Don't remind me" to turn it off.
settings.reminderHourHint: We will notify you from this time in your time zone.
settings.reminderHourInfo: The app checks reminders every hour on the hour. Each reminder is sent only once, at the first check from this time in your time zone. If the server was off at that time, it arrives at the next check that same day.
settings.reminderHourInfoLocal: The app checks reminders when you open it, when you come back to it and every minute while it is open. Each reminder is sent only once, at the first check from this time in your time zone. With the app closed they are not checked.

common.fileError: The file could not be opened

validation.minLength_one: Must be at least {{count}} character long.
validation.minLength_other: Must be at least {{count}} characters long.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.newDescription: Only make and model are required. You can fill in the rest later.

empty.all: You haven't added any vehicle yet.

vehicles.manageDescription: Archive vehicles you no longer use or mark them as sold: their history is kept.

form.currentOdometerHint: It will be saved as the first reading, dated today.
form.purchaseDescription: Used to work out the cost of ownership and for the sale report.

actions.markSoldDescription: The vehicle will leave your garage, but you'll keep its whole history.
actions.deleteDescription: The vehicle, its photo and all its mileage readings will be erased. This can't be undone. If you just want to hide it, archive it.

photo.invalid: That image couldn't be used. Try a smaller JPG, PNG or WebP.

odometer.pageDescription: Write down what each vehicle's odometer shows. Ikrive will remind you every week so mileage-based alerts stay accurate.
odometer.title: Mileage
odometer.description: Every reading feeds the alerts and the statistics.

errors.backwards: The mileage can't be lower than an earlier reading or higher than a later one.
errors.future: The date can't be in the future.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.deleteDescription: The record and its mileage reading will be erased. This can't be undone.

errors.odometerConflict: The mileage doesn't fit the vehicle's readings: it can't be lower than an earlier one or higher than a later one.
errors.future: The date can't be in the future.

attachments.title: Invoices
attachments.empty: This maintenance has no invoices yet.
attachments.help: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP · max. {{max}} MB
attachments.retryHint: Some invoices weren't uploaded. You can upload them again from the maintenance invoices.
attachments.deleteDescription: The invoice file will be erased. This can't be undone.

errors.type: “{{name}}” isn't a supported type: only PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.size: “{{name}}” is larger than the {{max}} MB limit.
errors.sizeUnknownLimit: “{{name}}” is larger than the allowed size.

fuel.title: Refuels
fuel.deleteDescription: The refuel and its odometer reading will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
fuel.recomputeHint: Clear a field to recalculate it from the other two.

errors.odometerConflict: The odometer does not fit the vehicle's readings: it cannot be lower than an earlier one or higher than a later one.
errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.twoOfThree: Fill in at least two of: quantity, total price and price per unit.

schedules.title: Upcoming maintenance
schedules.empty: No maintenance schedules yet. Add one to know when each service is due.
schedules.deleteDescription: The schedule will be erased. Linked maintenance records are kept but will no longer be tied to it.
schedules.noData: Not enough data to work out when it's due
schedules.lastDoneHelp: If you leave it blank, it counts from the vehicle's purchase.

errors.intervalRequired: Enter an interval in months or in {{unit}}

calendar.label: Add “{{title}}” to calendar
calendar.deviceError: Could not open the phone calendar
calendar.noDate: This schedule cannot be added to a calendar because it has no date: it is only due by distance and there are not enough readings yet to estimate when.

notificationChannels.title: Notification channels
notificationChannels.description: Get your reminders outside the app too: ntfy, Gotify, Apprise or your own webhook.
notificationChannels.empty: No channels yet. For now, reminders only show up in the app's bell.
notificationChannels.tokenKeep: A token is stored. Leave it blank to keep it.
notificationChannels.deleteDescription: You will stop getting reminders through this channel. In-app notifications are not affected.

errors.urlCredentials: Do not put a username or password in the URL: use the token field.

deviceNotifications.title: Phone notifications
deviceNotifications.description: New notifications show up as Android notifications while the app is open. To get them with the app closed, add a notification channel.
deviceNotifications.descriptionLocal: New notifications show up as Android notifications when you open the app or come back to it.
deviceNotifications.granted: On: new notifications will show up on this phone.
deviceNotifications.prompt: Off: the app is not allowed to show notifications yet.
deviceNotifications.denied: Off: the permission is denied. To turn them on, go to Settings › Apps › Ikrive › Notifications.

calendarFeed.title: Calendar
calendarFeed.description: Subscribe to your upcoming maintenance from your calendar app with a private URL. Google Calendar needs this server to be reachable from the internet; Apple Calendar, Thunderbird or ICSx5 also work on a local network or over a VPN.
calendarFeed.urlHint: Copy it now: for security it is only shown once. If you lose it, regenerate the feed.
calendarFeed.regenerateDescription: A new URL will be created and the old one will stop working: you will have to update it in your calendars.
calendarFeed.disableDescription: The URL will stop working and your calendars will no longer receive your maintenance.

pending.perYear: Needs odometer readings at least 30 days apart
pending.consumption: Needs two full-tank refuels with no missed refuel between them
pending.costPerDistance: Needs at least two odometer readings with distance driven

empty.distanceByMonth: Needs at least two odometer readings to show the distance per month.
empty.consumptionBySegment: Needs two full-tank refuels with no missed refuel between them to show the consumption.
empty.spendingByMonth: Needs a refuel or a maintenance record with a cost to show the spending per month.
empty.spendingByCategory: Needs a maintenance record with a cost to show the spending per category.

saleReport.title: Sale report
saleReport.description: Generate a PDF with the vehicle history for the buyer. Choose which details to remove.
saleReport.includeInvoicesHint: The invoices of the maintenance records in the report are appended at the end.
saleReport.freeTextWarning: Only the vehicle and maintenance fields are removed. If the alias, the version or the maintenance titles include the plate, the VIN or amounts, they will appear in the report.
saleReport.invoicesWarning: Invoices are appended as they are and may show those details.
saleReport.error: The report could not be generated. Try again in a few seconds.

reportShares.title: Share with a link
reportShares.description: Create a public link to the report with the checked options. It only works if this server is reachable from the internet; if it is not, download the PDF and send it.
reportShares.localWarning: This server is configured with a local address (BASE_URL): the link cannot be opened from outside your network. Download the PDF and send it.
reportShares.createError: The link could not be created. Please try again.
reportShares.urlHint: Copy it now: for security it cannot be shown again once you close this dialog.
reportShares.empty: You have not created any links for this vehicle yet.
reportShares.loadError: The links could not be loaded.
reportShares.revokeDescription: Whoever has it will no longer be able to open the report. This cannot be undone.
reportShares.revokeError: The link could not be revoked. Please try again.

dataPortability.title: Your data
dataPortability.description: Download a copy of everything you keep in Ikrive or import an export from another account or instance.
dataPortability.localDescription: Download a copy of everything you keep on this phone to take it to an Ikrive server.
dataPortability.exportHint: A zip with your vehicles, their history, invoices, photos and settings.
dataPortability.localExportHint: A zip with your vehicles, their history, invoices, photos and settings. Import it in "Your data" of your account: the currency and units must match.
dataPortability.confirmDescription: The data in “{{name}}” will be added to your account: nothing you already have is deleted or changed. The export currency and units must match your settings.
dataPortability.skippedChannels_one: {{count}} notification channel was not imported because it needs a token: create it again in “Notification channels”.
dataPortability.skippedChannels_other: {{count}} notification channels were not imported because they need a token: create them again in “Notification channels”.

matchingVehicles.title: Check these vehicles: you may already have had them

errors.invalid: The file is not a valid Ikrive export
errors.settings: The export currency or units do not match your settings
errors.duplicate: This export was already imported into your account
errors.export: The export could not be generated

adminUsers.deleteDescription: The account {{email}} will be deleted with all its vehicles, maintenance records, refuels and attachments. This cannot be undone.
adminUsers.demoteSelfDescription: You will lose administrator access right away and only another administrator can give it back.

locks.self: You cannot disable or delete your own account.
locks.last_admin: There must be at least one active administrator.

welcome.title: How do you want to use Ikrive
welcome.subtitle: Choose where to keep your vehicle data.

server.title: My server
server.subtitle: Type the address of your Ikrive instance.
server.invalid: Type a valid web address, such as https://ikrive.example.com.
server.unreachable: The server does not respond. Check the address and your connection, and that TRUSTED_ORIGINS on the server includes https://localhost.
server.notIkrive: That address responds, but it is not an Ikrive server.
